args.text: A popcorn shop. 1,526 coins at top. Three customers waiting at a red counter, each wanting popcorn. Middle row: a dispenser with three cones, two popcorn buckets on a conveyor. Bottom: a big popcorn cart with a circular red/yellow/blue ring around it, and a row of 9 small dots under it. Right side has machine cards. Bottom yellow button: upgrade for 175 coins, +11 -> +14. I think I can press the popcorn cart (maybe hold it, the ring looks like a timer/gauge), the upgrade button, and the side cards. I expect tapping the cart makes popcorn.

Tap on cart: coins 1526->1532, a puff of popcorn flew up to the middle row dispenser, two buckets moved along the conveyor toward the right. A new purple customer appeared on the left wanting a bucket. A needle appeared at top of the ring. The ring looks like a gauge (red, yellow, blue zones). Maybe holding fills it? Trying a hold.

Hold 2s: coins 1532->1554 (+22, much better than a tap's +6). Popcorn burst everywhere, two of the nine dots under the cart turned gold. A white marker sits at about 9 o'clock on the ring, at the top edge of the yellow arc. I think holding sweeps a needle around the ring and where I let go matters: yellow = good? Trying a slightly longer hold (2.6s) to land inside yellow.

Hold 2.6s: only +16, brown burnt-looking kernels spilled on the floor, dots stayed at 2. So too long = burnt. Guess: the needle goes clockwise from the top: blue (right side, underdone) -> yellow (lower left, perfect) -> red (upper left, burnt). 2s ended right at yellow/red border. Trying 1.7s to hit the middle of yellow.

YES. 1.7s hold: +94 coins, marker landed at ~8 o'clock inside yellow, two more gold dots (4/9 now). That felt great - golden popcorn. Theory confirmed: hold and release in the yellow band. The dots probably build to a bonus at 9. I'll keep doing 1.7s holds. Also I have 1,648 coins and the upgrade costs 175 - I'll buy it soon.

Second 1.7s hold: dots 6/9 gold, +35 total (a '+16' floated up from the customer counter - customers pay when served). A little magnifier/whisk icon popped up in the middle row over a station. Two more good holds should fill the nine dots - curious what happens.

Third good hold: a big shower of popcorn all over the bottom panel and the dots reset to empty - I think I completed the set (a combo/jackpot). Coins +55 though, not a huge jump; not sure if the jackpot paid out or the popcorn is still on its way. Now trying the yellow upgrade button at the bottom (175 coins, +11 -> +14).

Bought the upgrade: the cart grew wider with a gold star on top, next upgrade is 430 for +14 -> +18. Satisfying little visual change. The top-right machine card now has a red minus badge (was green dot) - not sure what that means, maybe that machine is broken/empty? The glass box in the middle row filled with popcorn. Buying the next upgrade too.

Second upgrade: cart even wider, pennants on top. Now 1,200 coins, next is 1,050 (+18 -> +23) - price jumped a lot. Customers' counter is empty right now. The ring's yellow arc looks the same size. Let me poke the machine cards on the right to see what they are.

Tapping the first side card selected it (yellow outline) and the bottom button switched to that machine: 450 coins, +19 -> +24. An info card covered the customer area: '19 > 24', a coin '-4' in red (running cost?), a check mark. Under the card, pause and coin icons; bottom-left of the cart panel shows clock 23, list 18. So these are extra machines that work on their own, each with an upgrade. Buying this one's upgrade.

Upgraded that machine to 24 (next 1,100, greyed - can't afford, 782 left). Uh oh: a red 'no entry' badge on the dispenser and a red box around the bucket shelf - the shelf is full (8 buckets), so I think production is jammed because nobody's buying. The info card hides the customer counter so I can't see if anyone is there. Going to tap the cart to close the card and get back.

Tapping the cart just made a small pop (+34 coins, shelf unjammed - jam badge gone) but the machine is still selected and the white info card still covers the customers. Annoying - I want to see my customers. Trying to tap the selected side card again to deselect it.
Tapping the side card again did nothing visible - still selected, info card still up. Coins slowly ticking up (840) on their own. Trying to tap the white info card itself to dismiss it.

Still stuck with the info card - tapping it did nothing. Shelf is full and jammed again (red badge). I'm getting a bit frustrated: I can't see customers. The round icon at the top-left of the cart panel (two red bars) turned yellow when I selected the machine - maybe it is the mode toggle. Tapping it.

That round icon was the way back - card closed, customer row visible again (just one blue customer). Bottom button back to the cart (1,050). Lesson: the round icon at each panel's corner selects that panel. Seems customers are the bottleneck - fewer customers than popcorn. Back to perfect holds for coins.

1.7s hold: +44, 2 gold dots. Marker landed lower in the yellow (about 7 o'clock) than before - so the needle may not start from the same place, or my timing drifts. Trying 1.5s to land mid-yellow. Customers still trickle in one at a time.

Huh - 1.5s produced a big grey smoke cloud over the cart and no new dot (+25 coins, probably from customers). No marker on the ring this time. Did I press too soon after the last batch, or did 1.5s land somewhere bad? Confusing. Waiting 3s to see the screen settle.
Smoke cleared. Coins creep up by themselves (~3/s). I'll try 1.8s - maybe the window shifted after I upgraded the cart (it got bigger).

Smoke again at 1.8s, no dot, no marker. So it's not just 'too short'. Two smokes in a row after it worked fine before. Maybe the kettle overheats if I press too often, or the timing window moved after upgrading the cart. Trying a shorter 1.0s hold to see where the marker lands.

1.0s: even darker, black smoke cloud. Something is wrong with the cart that isn't my timing. The glass box in the middle row is packed with popcorn and the shelf is nearly full, first side machine shows a red jam badge again. My guess: everything downstream is full, so whatever I cook just burns. Only one customer at a time. I'll stop pressing and watch for 5s whether the smoke goes away.

Smoke gone after resting. 1,102 coins, cart upgrade (1,050) is affordable again. But the bottleneck looks like customers, not popcorn. The customer panel has its own round icon top-left (a window/shop icon) - tapping it to see if I can upgrade the counter to get more customers.

Customer panel selected: the info card on the right shows a person icon 17.1 > 27.3, clock 3.5 > 2.2 (customers arrive faster?), 1 > 1, and a picture of the menu board getting bigger. Upgrade costs 1,100, '171 > 273'. This is what I need - more customers. Buying it (I have 1,130).

Bought the counter upgrade: down to 44 coins. Next level 2,400 would give a second line (1 > 2) and customers every 1.5s. Popcorn bits flying around. Now going back to the cart (tap its round icon) and making popcorn - hopefully more customers means no more burning.

Good hold again: golden burst, 4/9 dots, no smoke. Three customers at the counter now - the counter upgrade is working. The cart's own info card shows 18 > 23, a yellow arc 700 > 750 (the gold window size?), a dark arc 300 > 300. So the cart upgrade also widens the yellow band a bit. Keeping the rhythm to fill the 9 dots.

That hold did nothing visible - dots still 4, no burst, no marker. Maybe the cart is still busy/cooling from the last batch and ignores me. There's no clear 'ready' signal that I can see. I'll wait 3s and hold again.

Smoke again even after waiting 3s, with the same 1.7s hold that worked 30s ago. I really can't tell what the smoke means: too long? too soon? I never see the needle while I'm holding, only the marker afterwards, and on smoky ones there's no marker at all. The label next to the cart icon went from 21/14 to 23/24. Trying 1.3s.

1.3s: smoke again, darker. Three smokes in a row now. Four customers waiting though and coins still rising from sales (289). I've lost the trick and don't know why. Trying a single quick tap to see what the needle does.

Quick tap: no smoke, needle sits at 12 o'clock, a cloud bubble appeared over the glass box. Five customers queued now - the counter upgrade really brought people. One last 1.7s hold to see if the gold comes back.

Smoke again on 1.7s. Since the counter upgrade, every hold except one has smoked. Coins still climb (397) from customers buying, so the shop runs itself, but my one active skill stopped working and I can't figure out why. Final 30s - just watching it run.
